# Information on adding MRSA nares screening with new IV Vancomycin starts:

MRSA nares screening will be ordered on all new IV Vancomycin starts.

MRSA nares may be a helpful tool in identifying patients with low risk of MRSA infection in whom empiric vancomycin may not be required.

A negative MRSA nares does not definitively rule out the presence of MRSA elsewhere and is one factor to consider in the de-escalation of vancomycin (and other anti-MRSA antimicrobials).
